# Phase 13 — Advanced Agents

## Vision
Enable long-running autonomous agent systems with robust verification and recovery.

## Scope boundaries
- Multi-agent orchestration
- Persistent workflows and supervision
- Self-healing retry and recovery loops

## Dependencies on Phase 1
- Orchestration state machine
- Structured tools and verification gates
- Recovery layer and runtime state tracking

## Security constraints
- Permission-gated autonomous actions
- Full auditability of agent decisions
- Sandbox isolation for risky execution steps

## Rollout gates
- Agent simulation suites
- Bounded autonomy policies
- Incident response and rollback playbooks

## Success criteria
- Agents complete multi-step goals reliably
- Verification catches unsafe/incorrect actions
- Recovery limits cascading failures

## Risks
- Feedback loop instability
- Tool misuse under ambiguous intent
- Resource starvation from long-running tasks
